name: Ria Ariza
source:
Ria Ariza (may or may not be a stage name) is a bit of a celebrity. She's been secretly attending Texas A&N with her equally [url=/c148367]secret boyfriend[/url]  that [url=/c148291]MC[/url] quickly learns is quite the douche.

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-play-77484601]Patreon[/url]]

Ria Ariza is a rising star, enough to be recognized by anyone, but not enough to draw a crowd on the street. Not too unlike [url=/c148291]MC[/url], she was able to work her way up the chain from nothing. But she fears it comes at the cost of her independence.

[In game description]
